Appearance
From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

English

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • bhau, vai (Benglish)

Etymology

[edit]
PIE word
*bʰréh₂tēr

Transliteration of Hindustani بھائی (bhāī) / भाई (bhāī) and other South Asian languages, ultimately from Sanskrit भ्रातृ (bhrātṛ). Doublet of brother, bru, frater, friar, pal, and vai.

Noun

[edit]

bhai (plural bhais) (North India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Hinglish, Benglish)

  1. friend, dude, man
  2. brother

Caribbean Hindustani

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Hindi भाई (bhāī).

Noun

[edit]

bhai

  1. brother

Hlai

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Proto-Hlai *ɓəj (“bamboo raft”), from Pre-Hlai *Cəʔbəj (Norquest, 2015). Compare Proto-Tai *beːᴬ (“raft”) (whence Thai แพ (pɛɛ)), Middle Chinese 排 (MC beaj).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Hlai, Baoding) IPA(key): /ɓai˥˧/

Noun

[edit]

bhai

  1. bamboo raft

Southeastern Tepehuan

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Cognate with Northern Tepehuan báji, O'odham bahi, Mayo buasia, Hopi kwasi (“penis”).

Noun

[edit]

bhai (plural bhaabhai)

  1. tail

Etymology 2

[edit]

Cognate with O'odham s-bahi, Mayo buassi.

Adjective

[edit]

bhai

  1. cooked
  2. ripe
Related terms
[edit]
  • bhaayaꞌ
